sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module introduces the basic aspects of polymer synthesis, polymer properties, and polymer characterization.
sections.Learning outcomes: A name common monomers and polymers B understand the basic synthetic routes of step growth, chain growth polymerization and ‘living polymerization’ C discuss the methods available for the characterization of synthetic polymers D understand the relationship between polymer structure and physical properties E discuss the different methods available for synthesizing dendritic polymers
